(1 comment)
Change has been successfully merged
Please mention clearly which all properties, interfaces, and associations need pdi patch.
Done. Added explicit list of interfaces, properties, and associations that require a PDI patch in the commit message.
Shouldn't we add association only if tag value 2 exists?

Done. Added a loop to check if permanentMacAddressTag exists in addresses before adding the associated_ethernet_port_address association. Also replaced magic number 2 with a named constant.

See PS3..4:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/88775/3..4/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaEthPort.cpp
Is this for reverse association? If yes, then it is not needed. The association should work even without it.

Done. Removed the reverse association on the MAC address object. The forward association on the port object is sufficient — mapper creates the reverse automatically.

See PS3..4:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/88775/3..4/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaEthPort.cpp
Why are we iterating the `addresses` twice? Can't we create association in for loop that iterates over `addresses` below.

Done. From PS4 to PS6, the design was simplified:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/88775/4..6/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaEthPort.cpp

1. Removed the separate Network.LinkType interface — replaced by setting PortProtocol on the existing Connector.Port interface (new PDI: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/+/89248)
2. Removed the Permanent_MAC_Address sub-object and its association — MACAddress is now set directly on the port object
3. As a result, the for loop over addresses now only exists once to extract the MAC address. No more duplicate iteration.

All of the PDI patches has +1 and there is no update on those patches since 10 Jun. If there are any changes in those PDI patches before they are merged, the content of this patch will be reworked accordingly.
